Figure 2F counts each of the 201 test records once. In Figure 2 mapping, paper_unique_records gives these counts; paper pools 20 identical predictions per record. Rates are unchanged.
15-min U-TEG MA is the only input. All-report coverage is 100%. All classification metrics use the final continuous MA prediction with the same 50 and 70 mm boundaries.

Both models use inverse class-frequency weights (ratio capped at 20, mean one). The squared loss penalizes low-MA overestimation and high-MA underestimation fourfold. We fit standardization and weights using training records only.

Linear regression has a standardized slope and free intercept. RBF uses the current Gaussian kernel with gamma=1. Transfer adds a same-family local correction to the source prediction. We give source hospitals equal total weight.
Source and local penalties are 0.01 for both families. This matches the existing RBF setting; equal penalties do not imply identical effective model complexity.

Source penalty stays 0.01. We select local penalties from 0.0001, 0.001, 0.01, 0.1 and 1 using the same frozen inner folds and weighted asymmetric validation loss. Validation class weights come from inner training counts. Ties within 1e-12 favour larger penalties.

The fixed comparison counts each of 201 test records once (7 low, 170 normal, 24 high); all 20 fixed predictions coincide. The selected comparison pools 20 development partitions (4,020 events). Repeated events are not independent records.

FN counts abnormal references predicted normal; FP counts normal references predicted abnormal. Low/high recalls require the correct direction. Confusion columns give reference state to predicted state. MAE and RMSE are in mm; all rates are fractions.
Aggregate results and the analysis protocol are in Current_analysis_code.zip: LINEAR_RBF_RESULTS.json and protocols/LINEAR_RBF_PROTOCOL.json.

Figure 4 and the Figure 1 insets use "Matched operating points"; "Matched rank curves" supplies the aggregate prefixes. We match nominal coverage (10%, 20%, 40%) or observed agreement (85%, 90%, 95%). At 10 min, a passed 5-min prediction is retained only if the current prediction fails its development gate.
